name.evidence: District Court decree stamped p107: land 'known by the name of the Potrero y Rincon de San Pedro de Reglado' (the Board decree p75 spells it 'Regalado'). year.evidence: Board decree stamped p75: 'the grant made by Jose Bolcoff and Manuel Jimeno to Jose Arena on the 15th of August 1842'. For the Buelna tract no dated grant survives: petition p6 alleges only 'some time previous to the years 1838'; Bolcoff dep. p100: title from Micheltorena to Buelna 'was dated in 1842, 1843, or 1844'; Buelna dep. (per opinion p71) says title received 1842. Register's 1838 matches no grant document in the file

governor.evidence: Opinion p70/decree p75: 'Jose Ramon Estrada' as Prefect (register gives wrong initial 'Jose E.'); opinion p74: 'Manuel Jimeno, 1st Vocal of the Departmental Junta acting as Governor' approving/granting the Arana tract (register gives 'Jose Jimeno')

grantee.evidence: Opinion p70: grant alleged to 'Jose Ramon Buelna'; decree p75: grant 'to Jose Arena' (Arana). Register 'Jose R. Buelna; Jose Arana' matches both original grantees

land_case.evidence: p1 red label: 'CASE NO. 383 SOUTHERN DISTRICT'; PDF filename cubanc_lcf_sd383.pdf; DC captions p110: 'In D.C. No 383 ... In L.C. No 747' (Board docket 747)

outcome.evidence: Board 23 Oct 1855 (p74-76): Arana tract confirmed, Buelna tract rejected. District Court decree in open court 18 June 1859 (p106-108, Ogier J.): Board AFFIRMED as to Potrero y Rincon de San Pedro de Reglado and REVERSED as to the Mesa del Ojo de Agua tract, confirming both to claimants. US appeal to Supreme Court dismissed on motion of Atty Gen. Bates, Dec. Term 1863; mandate filed 10 Aug 1864 (p114-115). Final = confirmed

corrections.year: 1842 for the confirmed Arana grant, per Board decree p75: 'grant made by Jose Bolcoff and Manuel Jimeno to Jose Arena on the 15th of August 1842'; Buelna-tract grant date never established (lost/burned title)
corrections.governor: Jose Ramon Estrada (Prefect) for the Buelna tract; Manuel Jimeno (1st Vocal of the Departmental Junta, acting Governor) for the Arana tract (opinion p70, p74)

notes: Two-tract case (claimants Thomas Russell + Farnham heirs). name.evidence: No rancho name in the file: red label p1 styles it '446 BY 264 VARAS SQUARE, SAN GABRIEL GRANT'; grant (stamped p7-8) names no place, only a tract adjoining the garden 'Cuati' at Mission San Gabriel. 'Prospero' is a conventional name taken from the grantee

year.evidence: Grant translation stamped p8: 'Given in the City of Los Angeles the 16th of May 1843'; Spanish original p7: '...de mil ochocientos cuarenta y tres'; Board opinion p9: 'original grant made by Governor Manuel Micheltorena which bears date the 16th of May AD 1843'

governor.evidence: Grant p7: 'El Ciudadano Manuel Micheltorena Gobernador Comandante General e Inspector del Departamento de ambas Californias', signed 'Manl. Michelta.', Francisco Arce Secy ad interim

grantee.evidence: Grant p7: 'el Indigena de la Mision de San Gabriel llamado Prospero' - the grant names him only 'Prospero', an Indian of Mission San Gabriel; no surname anywhere in the file. 'Valenzuela' is the WIDOW's surname (claimant Rafaela Valenzuela, petition p4). Register's 'Prospero Valenzuela' attaches her surname to him

land_case.evidence: Red label p1: 'CASE NO. 135 SOUTHERN DISTRICT'; PDF filename cubanc_lcf_sd135.pdf; DC docket 135, Board transcript no. 418 (p18)

outcome.evidence: Board decree of confirmation 28 Feb 1854 (stamped p11, Felch/Campbell/Thompson). US filed petition for review (p18-20) but AG letter 9 Feb 1857 (stamped p36, filed 1 Feb 1858): 'confirmed to the claimant by the Commissioners, case no. 418, appeal will not be prosecuted by the United States'. Confirmation final

corrections.grantee: Prospero (an Indian of Mission San Gabriel; no surname in grant, p7-8). Register/patent tradition adds 'Valenzuela' from his widow Rafaela Valenzuela

notes: Size discrepancy inside the sources: grant p7 reads 'cuatrocientos sesenta y seis varas' (466) x 264, as does Hoffman, but the Bancroft label and Board certificate p13 say '446 by 264'. Grant month: translation and petition and opinion all say 16 May 1843; the Spanish original's month word at p7 is ambiguous at this resolution (could read Marzo) - year 1843 certain either way. No patent copy in file; register patent (Dec 4 1875, no. 419) left to Phase C. Hoffman name-mismatch flag is because Hoffman's rancho column is the size, not a name.

name.evidence: Board decree stamped p61: land 'known by the name of Punta de Reys, situated in Marin County'; opinion heading p59: 'For the place called Punta de Reyes in Marin County containing two leagues of Land in a square'. Bancroft binding styles the case 'Land in Marin County' (p1 red label), which explains the Hoffman name-mismatch flag

year.evidence: Board decree p61: 'being the same land granted to Jose Francisco Snook by Governor Alvarado on the 8th day of June 1839'. The register's 1836 is the date of the EARLIER 8-league grant to Berry: petition p5, 'on the 17th of March 1836 Nicolas Gutierrez then Governor of California by due form of law ceded a tract of Land to one James Richard Berry' - not the grant confirmed here

governor.evidence: Board decree p61: 'granted to Jose Francisco Snook by Governor Alvarado on the 8th day of June 1839'. (Note: paired with the register's 1836/Berry this is impossible - the 1836 Berry grant was by Gutierrez, petition p5. Alvarado is right only for the confirmed 1839 Snook grant)

grantee.evidence: Board decree p61: the confirmed land is 'the same land granted to Jose Francisco Snook by Governor Alvarado on the 8th day of June 1839'. Berry (register's grantee) was the 1836 grantee of the surrounding tract who expressly released these 2 leagues to Snook (petition p5, p8-9); title chain confirmed: Snook -> Osio (28 Sept 1839) -> Randall (8 Jan 1852) (opinion p59)

land_case.evidence: p1 red label: 'CASE NO. 385 NORTHERN DISTRICT'; PDF filename cubanc_lcf_nd385.pdf; DC caption p62: 'No 385: L.C. 772'

outcome.evidence: Board opinion + decree confirming, filed 11 Sept 1855 (p59-61, Felch/Thompson/Farwell); District Court decree of confirmation, Ogden Hoffman, 28 Dec 1857, Board decision 'in all things affirmed', US Attorney consenting (p62-63); AG notice 7 Feb 1857 no appeal (p67); order vacating appeal, claimant to proceed 'as under Final Decree', 24 May 1858 (p64-66)

corrections.grantee: Jose Francisco (Joseph Francis) Snook per Board decree p61; register's Berry is the 1836 grantee of the surrounding tract (grant by Gutierrez, petition p5)

notes: Hoffman 1862 prints the same hybrid row (1836/Alvarado/Berry) the register carries, so Hoffman agrees with the register AGAINST the case file - the decree governs. Randall was dead by summer 1856; Shafter affidavit p69 (June 1859): lands sold on execution to McMillan, conveyed 6 May 1857 to Heydenfeldt, O.L. Shafter, J.McM. Shafter, T.W. Park, who were substituted as parties (p70-72). No patent copy in file; register patent (4 June 1860, no. 33) left to Phase C.
